notes: Debugging session — mostly errors and fixes, almost no decisions. Stresses the error category.

messages.content: CI has been flaky for a week. Roughly one in four runs fails.
Looking at .github/workflows/ci.yml. Three failure modes so far: a port collision in the integration tests, a race in the fixture teardown, and an OOM on the Windows runner.
Fixed the port collision by binding to port 0 and reading the assigned port. Updated tests/conftest.py.
Fixed the fixture teardown race — the temp directory was removed while a background thread still held a handle. Added an explicit join in tests/conftest.py.
The Windows OOM is from the parallel test workers. Working on lowering the worker count for Windows in .github/workflows/ci.yml.
